projects.name: Key Features:
details: Key Features:
Designed and developed a Model-Driven Power Apps solution with Dataverse tables for managing job openings, candidates, and interview workflows.
Built automated Power Automate flows for resume parsing, interview scheduling, offer letter generation, and recruiter/manager notifications.
Integrated AI Builder to extract candidate skills and experience from uploaded resumes for faster shortlisting.
Implemented Power Pages for external candidates to apply and upload documents securely into the system.

Designed and developed the kiosk-based visitor registration app using Power Apps to capture visitor details, ID proof, and host selection.
Built automated approval workflows in Power Automate, including Teams adaptive card notifications for host approval or rejection.
